verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a search-results API vendor, since some SaaS products offer on-prem or self-hosted editions, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a hosted service: requests go to the serpapi.com endpoint with an API key, and pricing tiers are labeled 'Cloud'. Nothing documents a self-hostable core scraping and parsing engine; open-source client libraries and an MCP server repo are developer building blocks, not the core product.
